{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[prototype warship fleet]] from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] used a '''secret route''' through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that passed through the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was ambushed along the route by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] in [[3665 BBY]], and the resultant [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|battle]] reached its peak in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].
